// Plan_79 D3: registry keys and builder parameters are not refusal message literals.
const message = orderRuleMessage('known-rule', { violation: 'known-violation' });
die(orderRuleMessage('known-rule', { violation: 'known-violation' }));
die(message);
throw new Error(orderDiagnosticMessage('known-diagnostic'));
throw new Error(message);
throw new RunnerUsageError(orderRuleMessage('known-rule'));
throw new RunnerUsageError(message);
deny(orderDiagnosticMessage('known-diagnostic'));
deny(message);
const ruleResult = { reason: orderRuleMessage('known-rule'), refusal: message };
const diagnosticResult = { reason: message, refusal: orderDiagnosticMessage('known-diagnostic') };
problems.push(orderRuleMessage('known-rule'));
problems.push(message);
function ruleRefusal() { return orderRuleMessage('known-rule'); }
function diagnosticRefusal() { return orderDiagnosticMessage('known-diagnostic'); }
function identifierRefusal() { return message; }
